vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Skoda LH/RH = the vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). Numbers come from web-search result titles and extracts of the cited pages, mostly eBay UK breaker listings and new replacement panels that quote the OE number; no page could be fetched and no official Skoda catalogue was seen. One number (estate tailgate) was quoted in a search extract of an eBay UK category page without the listing's own URL; the category page is cited and its notes say so. Facelift (split headlamps) from 2017: pre-facelift or facelift fit is noted per part where the source gave years. Rear bumpers, rear lamps and the tailgate differ by body: in these listings 5E5 ... numbers are liftback (hatch, which some UK breakers call 'saloon') and 5E9 ... numbers are estate, so those are not auto-filled. Headlamps here are 5E2 941 ... units from UK listings; 5E1 941 ... headlamps were described as left-hand-drive in search results and are left out. Cooling parts vary by engine. Not researched or not found: front bumper absorber, front panel, radiator, left mirror indicator, right mirror cover, rear doors, rear bumper reinforcement, number plate lamp, badges, wheels (most Octavia Mk3s use indirect TPMS). Suffix letters change with revisions, trim and paint: verify every number by VIN.
